known_secrets.text: The near woodland has been shrinking for three generations, not one.
Official wood-count tallies from before the Turning are incomplete or missing.
Bran believes the kilns' fuel demand weakened the land before the river ever shifted.
He has kept his own private counts of the cutting boundary's retreat for twenty years.
He has never shown these counts to the Assembly.
He suspects Tarek Sabha already knows the woodland cannot meet current brick demand.
